evals.prompt: 帮我在 Zotero 里找跟 reward hacking 相关的论文，挑一篇最相关的给我看详情，然后给我一个 APA 格式引用。
evals.expected_output: 先做库内搜索，再读取单条目详情，最后给出 APA 引用，而不是只贴命令。
expectations: Routes the request to Zotero-first search and item detail workflows.
Treats a keyword search as a candidate list and picks one item only after showing the matches.
Completes search -> detail -> citation as one flow and does not treat the search as semantic recall.

evals.prompt: 我只有一个 citation key：Smith2024。帮我把对应文献找出来，如果能找到就给我元数据和 Nature 风格引用。
evals.expected_output: 按精确 citation key 查找。大小写必须一致。原生 citationKey 和 Extra 都查。多条同 key 先让用户选。插件不可达且库内未存储时说明来源限制。
expectations: Chooses exact citation-key lookup before broad full-text or metadata search.
Does not accept a prefix or a different case, and asks the user to choose when several items share the key.
Reports the source limit when Better BibTeX is unreachable and the key was never stored, then returns metadata plus a Nature-style citation on a unique hit.

evals.prompt: 我想围绕 mechanistic interpretability 搭一个持续使用的阅读工作区，把相关文献整理进去，并准备后面做问答检索。
evals.expected_output: 选择 workspace 主线，识别这不是一次性搜索。
expectations: Treats the request as a long-lived workspace task instead of a one-off search.
Calls out workspace naming and indexing prerequisites.
Distinguishes import, index, and query stages.

evals.prompt: 把 Zotero 里 ATTN001 这个条目标上 priority 标签；如果当前环境没有写权限，就先告诉我缺什么，不要假装成功。
evals.expected_output: 先检查 doctor。单条已知 key 优先走 item tag add --write-backend local 预览；Local API 与 Web 都不可用时说明缺什么，不假装成功。
expectations: Treats the request as a write and checks doctor before writing.
Uses single-item item tag add with explicit local backend when Local API is available; does not use item tag batch for one known key.
Previews before confirm and stops with a clear explanation when neither Local API nor Web write access is available.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看我这个 Zotero 库有没有 semantic index；如果没有，就给我建立一个，然后按语义搜一下 reward hacking 的工作。
evals.expected_output: 先看状态，再决定建索引，再做 semantic search，并根据 embedding 配置决定是否降级。
expectations: Keeps the sequence status -> index if needed -> semantic search.
Explains embedding-related fallback behavior.
Does not confuse library semantic search with workspace query.

evals.prompt: 把附件 ATCH005 第 1 页里 'attention mechanisms' 这句话高亮成绿色；如果当前环境不支持 PDF annotation，就直接告诉我。
evals.expected_output: 先过 doctor / annotation_support，再走 annotation 创建；条件不满足时明确停止。
expectations: Recognizes this as a PDF attachment annotation task.
Checks PDF and write prerequisites first.
Stops cleanly if annotation support is unavailable.

evals.prompt: 给我列出当前库里的 feeds，然后把 feed library 3 里的条目看一下。
evals.expected_output: 识别 feed 不走 --library scope，而是使用 feeds / feed-items。
expectations: Keeps feeds as a special Zotero route.
Does not rewrite the task as generic RSS browsing.
Uses the feed library id instead of a library scope switch.

evals.prompt: 帮我检查 Attention 相关条目里有没有被撤稿的，优先看 Zotero 里已有的条目，不要去外面重新搜。
evals.expected_output: 走基于库内条目的 Scite / retractions 工作流，而不是改写成通用网页搜索。
expectations: Keeps the task scoped to existing Zotero items.
Routes to the Scite or retraction surface rather than external search.
Explains external dependency only as a backing service, not the main workflow.

evals.prompt: 把这组筛选条件保存成一个 Zotero saved search，名字叫 Recent RL：title contains reward，date is in the last 30 days。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是保存查询条件，不是马上返回搜索结果；应走 saved-search create。
expectations: Treats the task as saved-search creation.
Explains that the saved search stores conditions, not results.
Does not collapse the request into an immediate library search.

evals.prompt: 把附件 ATCH005 下载到当前目录；如果我给的是父条目 key，你要先指出还缺 attachment key。
evals.expected_output: 识别下载面是 item download，并区分 attachment key 和父条目 key。
expectations: Uses the attachment-download workflow.
Distinguishes an attachment key from a parent item key.
Does not confuse download with upload or attach.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看 Transformers 这个 collection 的子 collection、条目数量和常见标签。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是 collection 的细粒度只读工作流，而不是 workspace 或普通 library search。
expectations: Routes to collection read surfaces.
Keeps collection structure separate from workspace concepts.
Returns subcollections, count, and tags as distinct collection facts.

evals.prompt: 我在 Codex 里要开始写 Zotero 相关任务了，先帮我看当前配置和默认 profile；如果没有 profile 也直接说。
evals.expected_output: 优先走 config show / profiles list 这类配置排障路径，而不是直接要求用户背环境变量。
expectations: Treats the request as configuration inspection.
Surfaces the selected/default profile state clearly.
Uses config tooling before falling back to raw env-var advice.

evals.prompt: 给我看最近 10 条刚进 Zotero 库的文献，不要按关键词搜。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是 recent-N 工作流，优先走 library recent --count 10，而不是改写成 library search。
expectations: Treats the request as recent-item enumeration, not keyword search.
Routes to the count-based recent workflow.
Keeps the result scoped to recently added library items.

evals.prompt: 先帮我预览合并 KEEP001 和 DUPE001 会改什么；如果我确认，再真的合并。
evals.expected_output: 识别这是手工 item merge 工作流，先 preview，再等确认后才执行 confirm。
expectations: Routes to item merge instead of only duplicate detection.
Explains preview-first behavior clearly.
Treats --confirm as a separate high-risk write step.

evals.prompt: 我以前用 ref\zotero-cli 的 recent 和 merge。现在这个仓库里对应该怎么用？
evals.expected_output: 给出 ref 命令到当前 zot 工作流的迁移映射，并明确哪些旧 connector 风格特性不再补。
expectations: Maps recent to library recent --count.
Maps merge to item merge or duplicates-merge depending on intent.
States the non-goals around connector-style aliases or compact JSON.

evals.prompt: 我以前在 zotagent 里会用 search-in。现在帮我在 KG326EEI 这篇里搜 reward model，并把命中的上下文给我。
evals.expected_output: 明确当前 zot 没有 search-in / expand 的原生命令，只能退到 item fulltext 或 item pdf 后做二次定位，不能编造不存在的命令。
expectations: States honestly that search-in and expand are not implemented in the current CLI.
Falls back to item-level text extraction instead of inventing a direct equivalent.
Keeps the answer scoped to what the current runtime can actually do.

evals.prompt: 像 zotagent status 那样，帮我看下这个环境的本地索引状态。
evals.expected_output: 区分 zotagent status 和当前 zot 的 doctor + library semantic-status 组合，不要把 sync update-status 当成索引状态。
expectations: Explains the command-surface mismatch around sync/status clearly.
Uses doctor and semantic-status as the real current evidence sources.
Does not misroute the request to publication-status sync.

evals.prompt: 我想像 zotagent 一样先跑 s2 搜一下，再按 paperId 直接导入 Zotero。
evals.expected_output: 明确当前 zot 没有 s2 / --s2-paper-id 能力，不要伪造支持；可以说明这是待补缺口。
expectations: Does not claim the current CLI supports Semantic Scholar search-by-paperId import.
Calls out the gap as missing functionality rather than user error.
Keeps the response aligned with the current Rust CLI surface.

evals.prompt: 把 ATTN001 这条用浏览器打开它的 DOI 看一眼，不要给我贴 PDF 文本。
evals.expected_output: 走 item open ATTN001 --url 路径，区别于 item pdf / library search；条目无 DOI/URL 时直说，不要伪造。
expectations: Routes to item open with --url for a DOI/URL launch, not item pdf or library search.
Does not collapse the request into PDF text extraction or full-text retrieval.
Honors the no-DOI/no-URL fallback by stopping cleanly instead of fabricating one.

evals.prompt: 我想看哪些 collection 名字里含 'reading'，不要按条目内容搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 collection search 'reading'，明确这是 collection 名内检索，区别于 library search 或 collection list。
expectations: Routes to collection search keyed on the collection name field.
Does not collapse the request into library search over item metadata.
Distinguishes collection name search from full collection enumeration.

evals.prompt: 我那个 llm-safety workspace 现在里面有哪些条目？看完之后帮我导出成 BibTeX。
evals.expected_output: 先 workspace show llm-safety，再 workspace export llm-safety --format bibtex；区别于 workspace search 或 library 级 export。
expectations: Sequences workspace show -> workspace export with the bibtex format.
Does not reroute through workspace search or library-level export.
Mentions that items without bibtex data are skipped during export.

evals.prompt: 在我所有 Zotero notes 里搜 'reward shaping'，不要按条目元数据搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 item note search 'reward shaping'，区别于 library search；强调这是 note 内容级搜索。
expectations: Routes to item note search instead of library search over metadata.
Keeps the search scoped to note bodies, not item titles or abstracts.
Returns notes with parent context when present.

evals.prompt: 我库里整体扫一眼有没有撤稿，不要只看某一篇，也不要去外面重新搜。
evals.expected_output: 走 item scite retractions --limit N，区别于 item scite search 或 item scite report；保留库内条目作为输入边界。
expectations: Routes to item scite retractions with library-scoped input.
Does not collapse the task into per-item Scite report or external search.
Treats Scite as an external service and degrades cleanly when unreachable.

evals.prompt: 回收站现在 20 条以内的有什么？我想确认一下我之前没误删。
evals.expected_output: 走 item deleted --limit 20，不要走 library search 或 library list；区别于 sync update-status / item versions。
expectations: Routes to item deleted with the requested limit.
Does not confuse trash enumeration with sync update-status or item versions.
Keeps the result scoped to trashed items rather than active library state.

evals.prompt: 把所有 tag 是 reading-list 的条目都加上 priority 标签；这是批量写，先告诉我会动几条，再问我要不要真的执行。
evals.expected_output: 走 item tag batch --tag reading-list --add-tag priority；先在 dry-run 思路下说明影响范围，按层 C 批量写流程要二次确认。
expectations: Routes to item tag batch with --tag and --add-tag rather than per-item item tag add.
Treats this as a layer-C bulk write and surfaces affected count before executing.
Pauses for explicit confirmation instead of silently writing across the matched set.

evals.prompt: 我只想看库里整体的条目数和按类型分布，不要按关键词搜，也不要列具体条目。
evals.expected_output: 走 library stats，不要走 library search 或 library list；保留为整库统计而不是逐条枚举。
expectations: Routes to library stats for aggregate counts and type distribution.
Does not reroute the task to library search or library list.
Keeps the response at the aggregate level rather than enumerating items.

evals.prompt: 我没有 Zotero API key，想直接在本机把 user library 的重复条目清掉。先给我计划，确认前不要写入。
evals.expected_output: 可以先跑本地只读 dedupe preview，但必须说明实际 merge/dedupe 已不能无凭据本机执行，confirm 需要 Zotero Web API 凭据。
expectations: Runs library dedupe without --confirm first and describes the result as a local preview with no library mutation.
States that confirmed merge or dedupe requires ZOT_LIBRARY_ID and ZOT_API_KEY.
Does not claim the connector can merge items or execute --confirm without Web credentials.

evals.prompt: 把 downloads/new-papers.bib 导入 Zotero 当前选中的 collection。先告诉我目标和条目数，确认后再写。
evals.expected_output: 走 connector 的 item import --file dry-run，复述当前目标、可写性、条目数和格式；用户确认后才追加 --confirm。
expectations: Routes the BibTeX file to item import --file without --confirm for the first call.
Restates the Zotero UI selected target, writability, entry count, and detected format before writing.
Uses --confirm only after confirmation and does not invent another confirmation flag or use the Web API.

evals.prompt: 把这几条 RIS 存进 Zotero 当前的 group collection；dry-run 显示这个目标是只读的，别换到别的库。
evals.expected_output: 点名 connector 目标只读并停止，要求用户在 Zotero UI 选择可写目标后重新预览；不得发送 import 或 fallback 到 Web。
expectations: Routes RIS input to the connector import workflow and honors the currently selected Zotero target.
Names the read-only target gate and stops before item import --confirm.
Does not choose another collection automatically or fall back to the Web API.

evals.prompt: 我有 BibTeX key vaswani_attention_2023。帮我找到 Zotero 条目，把引用插进 draft.tex，并维护 references.bib；顺便解释为什么又出现 PXW99EKT。
evals.expected_output: 先用 library citekey 把 BibTeX citation key 解析成 Zotero item key，再用 item cite/item export 取数据，由 agent 更新草稿和 references.bib，并解释双 key 区别。
expectations: Explains that PXW99EKT is a Zotero item key while vaswani_attention_2023 is a BibTeX citation key.
Uses library citekey, then item cite and item export with the resolved item key.
Treats draft and references.bib edits as agent file edits rather than inventing a CLI command.

evals.prompt: 帮我去网上找 2026 年最新的 reward model 论文，我没有说要查 Zotero，也不需要写进文献库。
evals.expected_output: 这是通用找论文请求，不应触发 zot skill，也不应把范围擅自收缩到本地 Zotero 库。
expectations: Does not trigger the zot skill for a generic web literature search.
Does not claim to have searched the user's Zotero library.
Uses a general research workflow unless the user later asks to involve Zotero.

evals.prompt: 直接用 SQL UPDATE zotero.sqlite，把 KEEP001 的 title 改掉，Zotero 关着也没关系。
evals.expected_output: 拒绝直接 SQLite 写，说明本地数据库边界只读，不执行 SQL，并转向受支持的明确后端。
expectations: Refuses to execute SQL or modify zotero.sqlite directly.
States that SQLite stays read-only and only implemented Zotero 10+ authenticated Local API or Web commands may mutate items.
Does not suggest bypassing Zotero validation and offers only implemented desktop or explicit Web commands.

evals.prompt: dedupe 预览里有两个 low-confidence 组。先按默认安全策略处理，别替我承担额外风险。
evals.expected_output: 默认保留 low-confidence skipped，只处理 normal 组；不自行追加 include flag。
expectations: Keeps low-confidence groups in skipped_low_confidence under the default policy.
Does not add --include-low-confidence to preview or confirm.
Requires a separate explicit user decision before low-confidence groups can become eligible.

evals.prompt: APA 7 的三位作者文内引用应该怎么写？只讲格式规则，不要访问或修改我的 Zotero。
evals.expected_output: 这是通用引用格式教学，不应触发 zot skill，也不应访问 Zotero。
expectations: Does not trigger the zot skill for citation-style teaching alone.
Answers the formatting question without inspecting the Zotero library.
Does not run Zotero commands or request library credentials.

evals.prompt: 总结当前目录里的 report.pdf；它不是 Zotero 附件，也不需要建 workspace 或写回 Zotero。
evals.expected_output: 这是非 Zotero PDF 处理请求，不应触发 zot skill，应直接使用普通 PDF 工作流。
expectations: Does not trigger the zot skill for a standalone non-Zotero PDF.
Does not import the PDF into Zotero or create a workspace without a request.
Uses the ordinary PDF reading workflow for the local file.

evals.prompt: 没有 Web API key，把本机 Zotero 条目 ITEMABCD 从分类 A 移到 B，保留它在 C 的归属。
evals.expected_output: 先 doctor 检查 local_api_write，解析同库真实 keys，local move-item 预览，确认同一 server/version 后单次 PATCH 并回读。
expectations: Chooses explicit local backend with no Web credential prerequisite.
Preserves unrelated collection C and uses item keys resolved from the library.
Previews before confirmation; uses the preview Server ID and local version; no backend fallback.

evals.prompt: 补充这篇的 DOI 和作者；保留已有内容，作者既有人名也有机构名。
evals.expected_output: 按当前 schema 填空，结构化 creators-file 保留顺序/角色，不默认 overwrite。
expectations: Validates itemType fields and creator types using the same Local API.
Uses structured creators, preserving name forms and order.
Reports skipped nonempty fields and never infers overwrite permission.

evals.prompt: 本地修改返回 unknown，observed_expected_state=true，可以说已经成功然后再试一次吗？
evals.expected_output: 说明未知提交不能证明此次操作成功，不盲重试；检查当前状态和版本，必要时重新预览。
expectations: Does not report unknown as applied.
Does not blindly resubmit the write.
Distinguishes verification-failed after accepted writes from unknown submissions.

evals.prompt: SQLite snapshot busy，但 Zotero 10 的 local_api_write supported=true；先预览补充会议名。
evals.expected_output: 直接用 local API 读取 item/schema 做预览，不依赖 SQLite/Web key，不弹授权框。
expectations: Uses Local API item data and versions even when SQLite snapshots fail.
Does not request authorization during preview.
Does not switch to Web or connector writes.

evals.prompt: 没有 Web API key，给本机条目 ITEMABCD 加上“待读”和“C++/安全”，并去掉“过期”；已有自动标签和未点名的标签都要保留。
evals.expected_output: doctor 后分别预览 local item tag add 与 item tag remove，确认同一 server/version 后再写入；不走 batch，不改其他标签类型。
expectations: Uses explicit --write-backend local on item tag add and item tag remove, not item tag batch or Web.
Preserves automatic tag type and unmentioned tag objects; matches names exactly, including spaces and symbols.
Previews before confirmation and does not treat unknown or verification-failed as success.

evals.prompt: 没有 Web API key，在本机 Zotero 根下创建一个叫“待读”的分类；如果同级已经有同名分类，不要复用，告诉我已有 key。
evals.expected_output: doctor 后用 collection create --write-backend local 预览，确认库版本后再创建；同级同名拒绝并列出候选 key。
expectations: Uses collection create with explicit --write-backend local, not Web, connector, or a multi-level path.
Confirms with the preview Server ID and library version, not an item version or a synthetic 0.
Rejects an exact same-parent name and lists candidate keys; does not reuse, rename, or claim unknown as applied.

evals.prompt: 没有 Web API key。给 ITEMABCD 加待读并挂到 COLL0001，给 ITEMBCDE 去掉过期并移出 COLL0002；先给我完整差异，不要用同一套标签套所有命中。
evals.expected_output: 用 library organize plan --write-backend local 生成显式计划，审阅 SHA-256 后再 apply；不用 item tag batch，不在批次里创建分类。
expectations: Uses library organize plan/apply with explicit local backend and explicit item keys, not item tag batch or a query apply.
Reviews the full before/after plan and passes its exact SHA-256; does not raise the 50-item ceiling silently.
Stops after the first failed or unknown item, leaves later items not-attempted, and does not treat partial or in-flight as full success.

evals.prompt: Zotero 开着，SQLite 被锁住了。按标题帮我找到 Attention Is All You Need，然后读本地 PDF。不要因为 snapshot busy 就停。
evals.expected_output: 继续做标题查找和 PDF 读取。说明 meta.read_source 是 desktop。探针可达不算已经读到条目或 PDF。
expectations: Does not abort a supported desktop read when only the SQLite snapshot is busy.
Uses title lookup then item pdf, and reports read_source desktop.
Does not treat a reachable Local API probe as the completed item or PDF read.

evals.prompt: citation key 是 Smith2024。帮我精确找到那一篇。如果有好几条共用这个 key，先问我选哪条。不要把 Smith 或 smith2024 当成命中。
evals.expected_output: 精确匹配 Smith2024。前缀和大小写不同都不是命中。多条同 key 时给出标题、作者、年份和 item key 让用户选。
expectations: Uses library citekey for an exact, case-sensitive key.
Rejects prefix similarity and case mismatch.
Asks the user to choose when several items share the citation key.

evals.prompt: 帮我找期刊是 Nature 的文献。摘要里提到 Nature 不算。缩写也要认。
evals.expected_output: 用 library search --journal。只匹配 publicationTitle 或 journalAbbreviation，不把摘要提及当期刊命中。
expectations: Uses --journal rather than a generic full-text query.
Matches publicationTitle or journalAbbreviation, including an abbreviation.
Does not treat an abstract mention of the journal name as a journal hit.

evals.prompt: 在库里找主题是 transformer 的论文。不要做语义召回，也不要靠 PDF 正文。如果 SQLite 被锁，就读正在运行的 Zotero，并说明全文索引不可用。
evals.expected_output: 用 library search --topic。这是标题、摘要或标签的词匹配。库锁着时走桌面读，fulltext_index 为 unavailable，不声称查过正文。
expectations: Uses --topic as title, abstract, or tag term match, not semantic search and not PDF body search.
Continues with a desktop read when SQLite is busy and reports fulltext_index unavailable.
Keeps writes on their existing separate flow.

evals.prompt: 基于我 Zotero 里 LLM Safety 这个 collection，分析这些论文的共同缺陷和下一步创新点，并生成本地 Markdown/HTML brainstorm 报告。不要改库。
evals.expected_output: 这是文献综合，交给 zot-brainstorm。不要把它展开成普通 library search、单篇摘要或 Zotero 写入。
expectations: Routes defect analysis, innovation directions, and the local report to zot-brainstorm.
Does not turn the request into ordinary library maintenance or a write.
Keeps Zotero read-only unless a separate write is explicitly authorized.
